$Comment: Percent faster growth for the crops, saplings and fishing traps a player placed, in whole percent points, held at the cap this file's ZigCeiling tag names (200, three times as fast at most; nothing raises it, and a server changes it by shipping this file with another value). ziggfreed-common's growth step (world/gather/GrowthSpeedSystem) credits that share of the time that passes to each such block's growth while its placer is in the same world, so it grows the same way, only sooner. A talent that counts only at night grants it bound While that condition. Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
